קכו.ja: לנעמתה ופצ'לה, ולא קדר לי פי עט'ים ג'נודה, ולא קימה לאמרי פי ג'לאלהֵ קדרתה סבחאנה.
קכו.en: no limit to His blessing and His bounty; no measure for me amid the magnitude of His armies, no value for my matter amid the majesty of His power, glorious is He.

pairs.en: no limit to His blessing and His bounty
no measure for me
amid the magnitude of His armies
no value for my matter
amid the majesty of His power
glorious is He

קכו.ja: פפהם אלצבי מן אמר אלמלך מא כאן יג'הל, ועט'ם קדרה פי נפסה, והאב אמרה, ואסתעט'ם נעמתה ומא ורדה מן קבלה לעט'ים שאנה, וצגר קימהֵ אלצבי פי מלכה, ואסתג'זל מואהבה.
קכו.en: The child understood, from the matter of the king, what he had been ignorant of; magnified his power in his own soul; held his command in awe; reckoned his blessing great, and what had come to him from the king's side, on account of the greatness of His estate; reckoned the value of the child within his kingdom slight, and his gifts abundant.

pairs.en: The child understood
from the matter of the king
what he had been ignorant of
magnified his power in his own soul
held his command in awe
reckoned his blessing great
and what had come to him from the king's side
on account of the greatness of His estate
reckoned the value of the child within his kingdom slight
and his gifts abundant

קכו.ja: ואנת יא אכ'י עלי מת'ל ד'לך פי אלפלך אלמחיט באלארץ', פאנא לא נעקל מא פי אקל בקעה מן אלארץ' פצ'לא ען ג'מלתהא, פכיף מא ורא אלפלך.
קכו.en: And you, O my brother, are the like of this regarding the sphere encompassing the earth — for we do not reason what is in the least patch of the earth, much less the whole of it, much less what is beyond the sphere.

pairs.en: And you, O my brother
are the like of this
regarding the sphere encompassing the earth
for we do not reason

pairs.ja: מא פי אקל בקעה מן אלארץ'
pairs.en: what is in the least patch of the earth
much less the whole of it
much less what is beyond the sphere

קכו.ja: פתפהם יא אכ'י הד'א אלמת'ל ואעתבר בה, ואפהם ען מעני אלכ'אלק ג'ל ועז בחסב ד'לך ליעט'ם פי נפסך מא מנחך בה מן נעמה ופצ'אילה באחתפאלה בך מע ג'מלהֵ מכ'לוקאתה,
קכו.en: So comprehend, O my brother, this parable, and reflect by it; and grasp the concept of the Creator (mighty and exalted) according to this — so that there grow great within your soul that with which He has graced you of His blessings and bounties in His regard for you among the totality of His created things.

pairs.en: So comprehend, O my brother, this parable
and reflect by it

pairs.ja: ואפהם ען מעני אלכ'אלק ג'ל ועז
pairs.en: and grasp the concept of the Creator (mighty and exalted)
according to this
so that there grow great within your soul

pairs.ja: מא מנחך בה מן נעמה ופצ'אילה
pairs.en: that with which He has graced you of His blessings and bounties
in His regard for you
among the totality of His created things

קכו.ja: ואנט'ר פי כתאבה ואמרה ונהיה בעין ג'לאלה, ואכ'טר עלי באלך עט'ים היבתך ואג'לאלך לכל מא ידרכך מן נעמהֵ מן הו פוקך מן אלנאס,
קכו.en: Look upon His Book, His command, and His prohibition with the eye of His majesty; and bring before your mind the magnitude of your dread and your reverence for whatever may come to you of a blessing from the one above you among people —

pairs.en: Look upon His Book, His command, and His prohibition
with the eye of His majesty
and bring before your mind
the magnitude of your dread and your reverence
for whatever may come to you of a blessing
from the one above you among people

קכו.ja: פאן עלי קדר פצ'ל מנזלתה מן מנזלתך וגנאה ענך יכון קדר ג'לאלהֵ נעמתה פי נפסך,
קכו.en: for according to the measure of the bounty of his rank above your rank, and his freedom-from-need-of-you, will be the measure of the majesty of his blessing in your soul.

pairs.en: for according to the measure
of the bounty of his rank above your rank
and his freedom-from-need-of-you
will be the measure of the majesty of his blessing
in your soul

קכו.ja: וכד'לך יכון לאמרה ונהיה בחסב ד'לך קדרא פי נפסך וסעיך ואג'תהאדך לה, פאפהם ותפהם תצב אן שא אללה.
קכו.en: So likewise it shall be, for His command and His prohibition, according to that — a measure in your soul, in your striving, and in your effort for Him. So comprehend and understand — you shall hit the mark, God willing.

pairs.en: So likewise it shall be
for His command and His prohibition
according to that
a measure in your soul
in your striving, and in your effort for Him
So comprehend and understand
you shall hit the mark
God willing

קכו.ja: ג'עלנא אללה ואיאך מן אלפאיזין בטאעתה, ואלממייזין לצ'רוב נעמתה ברחמתה וראפתה תעאלי.
קכו.en: May God set us and you among those granted success in His obedience, those who discriminate the various kinds of His blessing — by His mercy and His pity, exalted is He.

pairs.en: May God set us and you
among those granted success in His obedience
those who discriminate the various kinds of His blessing
by His mercy and His pity
exalted is He
